contexts.text: I have heard a consummation and decision ().
Seventy weeks are decreed upon thy people ().
Even to the consummation and decision ().
Under Consummate, see these references. AR 478:2. TCR 755:end. AE 374:9.
Suspense as to the combat between falsity and truth, and no decision. Signified.
Without such an Intellectual, he could never come to a decision as to what is true.
Consummation and decision in these passages = the last state of the Church, which exists when there is no longer truth because there is no longer good... and then comes the Last Judgment.

This will of good, when it is determined to this use, becomes... the affection of truth, then the perception of truth, and presently, by means of rational light, the thought of truth, thus decision and conclusion...
